protocol.pattern_scope: Own fixed clock/geometry masks only; not official R3 or hidden-instance reconstruction
protocol.target: Eligible cells inside pattern; all pattern numeric observations withheld before input construction
protocol.selection: None. Same A33 source-cal checkpoints and fixed .5 interpolation blends as B07.
protocol.quality_profile_occupancy: Same filtered inputs, geometry-only profile and unavailable occupancy as B07

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Three seed clusters, masks share latent/noisy truth. Pattern scores use their own differing target populations, not a paired mask-effect gain. Within-pattern model contrasts only. No simulator assessment selection or production promotion.
